items.title: Zeno UI
items.summary: Token-first component system for building clean web interfaces with Tailwind-driven primitives and a theme playground.
items.description: A compact UI library and playground focused on reusable primitives, tokenized styling, and fast theme iteration.

items.title: Recur Obj Model
items.summary: A modular video object analytics pipeline for counting unique recurring objects across an entire video, even after scene cuts.
items.description: Built in Python with scene detection, sampled frame processing, YOLOv8n detection, ByteTrack tracking, and CLIP-based re-identification to merge local tracks into persistent global object IDs with analytics export.

items.title: Article FM
items.summary: A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that adds a listen flow to X pages by extracting article-like content and playing generated audio in a floating mini-player.
items.description: Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, and Zustand. The extension injects a listen action on `twitter.com` and `x.com`, handles SPA navigation changes, passes extracted content through the background worker, and renders a compact top-right player.
